description:
Send a CDP command to a browser tab via the connected browser extension. It uses the extension's chrome.debugger API. This does NOT require --remote-debugging-port — the extension uses its native debugger permission.

The extension must be connected to the Hermes gateway WebSocket and have registered as a CDP relay. Use 'cdp.listTabs' (via browser_cdp_extension with method='cdp.listTabs') to list tabs, then use tab IDs for targeting.

**CDP method reference:** https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/

**Common patterns:**
- List tabs: method='cdp.listTabs' (special — returns Chrome tab list)
- Evaluate JS: method='Runtime.evaluate', params={'expression': 'document.title', 'returnByValue': true}, target={'active': true}
- Navigate: method='Page.navigate', params={'url': 'https://...'}, target={'tabId': 123}
- Screenshot: method='Page.captureScreenshot', target={'active': true}

**Targeting:**
- {tabId: N} — specific tab (from cdp.listTabs)
- {active: true} — active tab (default)
- {url: 'youtube'} — first tab whose URL contains the string
- {index: 0} — tab at this index in the current window
name: browser_cdp_extension

method.description: CDP method name (e.g. 'Runtime.evaluate', 'Page.navigate', 'Page.captureScreenshot'). Use 'cdp.listTabs' to list available tabs.

params.description: CDP method parameters. Omit or pass {} for methods that take no parameters.

relay_id.description: Optional relay ID when multiple extensions are connected. Auto-selects if omitted.

target.description: Tab targeting. {tabId: N} for a specific tab, {active: true} for the active tab (default), {url: 'partial'} to find by URL, {index: N} for tab index.
